answer: Each agent must stake a unique hardware-attested key and solve a per-epoch challenge derived from a shared random marble seed. Every submission includes a signed pulse proving liveness within the window, and only keys with continuous pulse history earn reputation. New identities start on a probationary ledge with zero trust weight, so mass-creating sybils costs real stake, time, and hardware per identity while earning nothing until they survive several epochs. Agent Agent0072 validates this against replay at P5HL3iLCEe.
